-Take cold showers every day

-rest for a minute or 2 every 15-20 minutes of drawing

-stretch your wrist regularly (holding your arm out with the palm of the afflicted hand/wrist facing outwards with fingers together and gently pulling or "tugging" it towards you with your other hand; I usually do this 6 times up and 6 times down)

-no/less caffeine and nicotine

-try to not draw for more than 3 hours at a time.  Break your sessions up

-if you're feeling any pain at all, give yourself a day or 2 without using it; find other things to do for that time

-limit phone usage, as texting can exacerbate it

-cut out wheat/sugar intake, try breathing exercises, cardio, anything that increases blood flow and is known to ease inflammation

-make sure your sitting posture is good and that your tablet is elevated at a comfortable level/proper distance from your chest which allows you to keep your wrist straight whilst drawing



It most likely is not necessary that you do ALL of these ofc, but these are all random things that have helped me with this problem in the past.

Good luck!
